implemented: Fluid Media grid with single caption rows, duration chips, signed access, unavailable/hidden states and version viewing.
Search, picture/clip filters, sorting, Show hidden, empty/no-match states. Clear search preserves other visibility settings.
Non-destructive hide/restore and idempotent, independent copies to another owned active project. Copy intent reserves the target identity before storage work.
Native GCS resumable imports with 8 MiB chunks, durable owner/project intents, IndexedDB bytes when available, missing-file recovery and matching SHA-256 reselection.
Server verifies actual MIME, full fingerprint, byte count, decoded picture geometry and clip stream/duration before writing a MediaVersion.
Reusable Import panel: file choice starts transfer; checking stays Uploading; success closes it; dismissal keeps transfer running; cancellation stops transfer and reconciles uncertain outcomes.

Composer picker and imports share an anchor 6px above the composer. Selecting ready media applies it immediately. Waiting import roles persist separately from bytes; completion does not restore removed roles or change another draft.

limits.pictures: PNG/JPEG/WebP, 10 MiB, at most 40 million pixels; animated pictures are rejected.
limits.clips: MP4/WebM, 500 MiB, up to one hour, at most 40 million pixels per frame.

acceptance.MEDIA-01: Real signature/decode/hash tests reject unsupported and truncated content before publication; browser rejection state captured.
acceptance.MEDIA-02: Firestore races and duplicate finish converge one MediaVersion. Native GCS resumed a 9 MiB object from byte 8388608.
acceptance.MEDIA-03: Browser and hook tests retain the original identity when same-name bytes differ; matching bytes resume.
acceptance.MEDIA-04: Two persisted drafts share an importing reference; removing A leaves B and the import intact. Browser removal preserved words and did not stop transfer.
acceptance.MEDIA-05: Cancelled references remain unavailable, including late completion. Uncertain native cancellation remains recoverable until storage reconciliation confirms it.
acceptance.HISTORY-11: Source remains intact; copy receives an independent object and no private context. Browser copy preserved an existing destination draft byte for byte.
